content:
Use Seedance 2.0 “Character DNA” with a reference image and explicitly instruct: preserve her facial identity exactly as shown in the reference image.  
Prevent face cloning in multi-character scenes by adding constraints like: Never duplicate the face of @image1 and specify unique faces/appearances for ensemble and audience.  
Structure your prompt as a timecoded shot list (e.g., 00:00–00:01.5, 00:01.5–00:03.0, etc.) with camera directions per beat (slow push-in, wide shot, tracking close-up, orbit, overhead crane, fast dolly-in, hero shot).  
Lock in cinematic look by specifying capture/optics settings in the prompt: ARRI Alexa 65, anamorphic lenses (35–75mm), 24fps, HDR, cinematic motion blur, shallow depth of field, volumetric lighting.  
Improve scene coherence by defining separate “DNA” blocks for Supporting Cast, Audience, and Visual environment (location, lighting, atmosphere, materials) before the shot-by-shot actions.
